jobs.title: Release Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job title** : *Release Coordinator*

**Location** *: Hyderabad*  
  
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
**About the job:**  
Our team is engaged in designing and delivering Digital Tech Services worldwide. We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting highly regulated environments (GxP, SoX, and other regional and local regulations). Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world. To reach our goals we have organized our model around 7 main pillars:
  
  

* Enterprise architecture
* Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Platforms
* Digital Workplace
* Integration Platform
* ERP
* Service Now Platform
* Salesforce Platform

  
**Main Responsibilities:**  
  
This position is a senior role responsible for coordinating and ensuring the successful execution of all release management activities related to Integration changes (interfaces) across Opella’s global ecosystem. This includes:
  

* Coordinate end-to-end release activities for all integration-related deployments, ensuring execution quality, schedule adherence, and risk mitigation according to the integration governance process.
* Prepare, maintain, and communicate the integrated release calendar for all interface deployments across the Integration Platforms.
* Perform detailed readiness checks, ensuring all prerequisite activities, build, testing, documentation and approvals are fully completed prior to release execution.
* Oversee the creation, validation, and execution of release plans, including rollback strategies, dependency management, and release sequencing.
* Act as the primary point of contact during release windows, coordinating cross-functional teams (Integration, Infra, SAP, project teams, vendors) to ensure smooth deployment.
* Ensure adherence to governance, compliance, and quality requirements related to Integration deployment activities (GxP, SoX, InfoSec, data privacy).
* Coordinate post release validation and ensure defects/issues are properly tracked, assessed, and resolved.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in release processes, including automation, documentation, monitoring, and communication practices.
* Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reporting to provide visibility into release performance, trends, and future capacity needs.
* Foster strong collaboration with project managers, product owners, developers, testers, and operational support teams.
* Promote and advocate best practices in Integration release management, ensuring consistent execution across all markets and platforms.
* Own and evolve the integration catalog as the main artifact repository for Interfaces.

  
**About You:**  
Technical Background Required
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in Release Management, Integration technologies, or similar roles supporting complex enterprise landscapes.
* Good understanding of Integration technologies, API lifecycle, messaging patterns, middleware concepts, and interface operations.
* Proven experience planning and coordinating releases within enterprise environments, ideally including cloud and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD principles, DevOps practices, and deployment automation.
* Experience working with highly regulated sectors or compliance-driven environments is a strong plus (GxP, SoX, InfoSec).
* Good understanding of infrastructure, networking, and application dependencies relevant to interface deployments.
* Familiarity with modern digital technologies: Cloud platforms (Azure), API gateways, iPaaS, DevSecOps, Infra-as-Code, observability tools, etc.
* Excellent communication abilities to articulate release plans, risks, and impacts to technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience with ERP systems, particularly SAP integration processes, is a plus.

  
**Soft Skills Required**  

* Excellent coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple releases and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to remain calm and effective in high-pressure release windows.
* Ability to work cross-functionally in a global matrix environment, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Strong communication skills: clear, concise, and able to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement orientation.
* Demonstrated accountability, ownership, and attention to detail.
* Ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and drive disciplined execution.

  
**Why us?**  
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Job Description  
About the team

The CRM & Industry Workflows (CRM&I) engineering organisation builds the products behind ServiceNow's CRM vision: Workplace Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, Sales & Order Management, and the shared CRM Foundation. Our teams operate from IDC, AMS, and EMEA, and our work spans foundational platform capabilities to the agentic experiences that define how enterprises serve their employees and customers.

AI is not a layer we are adding on top. It is the new baseline. We are rewriting how products are built, how engineers work, and what "done" means.

The role

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Workplace engineering team, you will build features for Workplace Service Delivery and its integrations with CSM and FSM, delivering employee and customer experiences that handle millions of service interactions for our largest enterprise customers.

This is not a role where AI is a productivity tool on the side. You will work AI-native: breaking problems into agent-sized tasks, curating the context that makes agent output reliable, and verifying what ships. You own a feature from specification to production, including its quality.

You will work independently with general guidance from your engineering manager and architect, partner closely with product, UX, and platform engineers, and document and present your designs within your team and across adjacent teams.

What you get to do

**Own features end to end**

* Turn loosely defined problems into clear, testable specifications and designs that both engineers and AI agents can act on.
* Build across the stack (UI, workflows, APIs, data model, integrations) and own the feature through release and production behaviour.
* Write design documents and present them to your team and adjacent teams.

**Work AI-native, every day**

* Use agentic coding tools as your default way of working: break work into agent-sized tasks, review output critically, and own its correctness.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Onboarding & KYC
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
  
  
We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
* Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
* Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
* Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for**

* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.

+ 8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role

* A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,

**Nice to have**

* Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding,
* Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.
  
  
On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.
  
  
On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.
  
  
Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.
* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.
* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.
* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.
* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.
* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.
* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.
* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.
* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.
* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.
* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.
* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Product Manager - Tax
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the product: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* Go deep on the technical detail: Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48) into precise specifications.
* Engage clients directly: Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* Support the roadmap: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* Grow with the role: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.

**What You'll Need**

* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high-tech software development environment.

Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.
  
  
**Recruiting Security**
Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
  
  
*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high-quality, high-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.

  

As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.

* Comfort working within a complex, rules-driven engine where changes can have wide-reaching downstream effects
  
* Experience with loyalty, rewards, promotions, or CRM platforms is a strong plus

jobs.title: Dam Safety Product and Domain Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
The Ksquare Group is a consulting company that delivers cutting-edge technological solutions through customized projects that enhance decision-making speed and quality. By partnering with leading technologies, the organization accelerates digital transformation initiatives for its clients. The Ksquare Group has strong expertise in Salesforce and data solutions, helping organizations modernize their processes and systems. Team members collaborate with diverse clients and technologies, contributing to impactful innovation across industries.

**About the role**

We're building a digital platform to modernize how dams are inspected, assessed and monitored — replacing paper checklists, scattered spreadsheets and after-the-fact reporting with a system inspectors, dam owners and regulators can actually rely on. This is a greenfield effort, and we're deliberately running it as a start-up inside The Ksquare Group, small team, fast decisions, direct contact with users, and accountability for outcomes rather than tickets.

We're looking for a lead who can carry three things at once — domain, technology, and product. You've worked in or close to dam safety, hydropower, water resources or civil infrastructure; you can design and ship software, not just specify it; and you think in terms of what users need and what moves the business, not just features.

**What you'll do**

* Own the product end to end: discovery with inspectors, owners and regulators; roadmap; prioritization; and delivery.
* Translate dam safety practice — inspection protocols, hazard classification, instrumentation data, emergency action planning, regulatory reporting — into a workable product and data model.
* Work with architect and build the platform's early versions between the two, then hire and lead a small engineering team as the product proves out.
* Make pragmatic technology choices for field conditions: offline-first mobile capture, photo and geospatial data, sensor integration, structured reporting.
* Run pilots with early customers, learn fast, and shape the commercial model alongside the founders.
* Set the culture and operating rhythm of a start-up team: ship weekly, measure usage, kill what isn't working.

**What we're looking for**

* 8+ years across software product development, with meaningful time in both hands-on engineering and product ownership.
* Domain exposure to dam safety, hydropower, water infrastructure, geotechnical/structural inspection, or a closely related regulated asset-heavy sector.
* Experience taking a product from zero to first paying users — ideally as a founder, founding engineer or early product lead.
* Strong full-stack capability (e.g. modern web/mobile frameworks, cloud services, data pipelines); comfortable with GIS, imagery, or IoT/sensor data a plus.
* Ability to sit with a field inspector in the morning and present to a regulator or executive in the afternoon.
* A bias toward ownership, ambiguity tolerance, and building rather than planning.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

*Regulatory & Domain Knowledge*

* Working knowledge of the Dam Safety Act 2021, including the roles of the National Dam Safety Authority (NDSA), State Dam Safety Organisations (SDSOs), and NDMA
* Familiarity with the DHARMA portal and dam health data reporting requirements for public and private dam owners
* Understanding of the Centre–State division of responsibilities for water resources, and the ability to design workflows that support state-level decision authority with central technical guidance

*Monitoring & Inspection Technology*

* Hands-on experience integrating IoT sensors (piezometers, seepage meters, inclinometers, strain gauges, etc.) for real-time structural health monitoring of dams
* Experience with drone-based visual and thermal inspection, including image capture, processing, and defect detection
* Experience with satellite remote sensing (InSAR, optical, hydrological datasets) for deformation and reservoir monitoring
* Ability to design and implement early warning systems with automated alerting and threshold-based triggers

*Climate & Hydrological Risk*

* Ability to incorporate updated rainfall data, Probable Maximum Flood (PMF) revisions, and Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) risk into monitoring models and risk scoring
* Experience assessing ageing infrastructure and prioritising rehabilitation needs (e.g., under DRIP or similar schemes)

*Emergency Preparedness & Community Interface*

* Experience supporting Emergency Action Plans (EAPs), including inundation mapping, evacuation planning, and mock-drill scheduling and tracking
* Ability to build multilingual, low-literacy-friendly interfaces for local community alerts and EAP dissemination

*Data, Compliance & Governance*

* Experience building compliance tracking and audit workflows (e.g., flagging missing safety data submissions, licence conditions, inspection schedules)
* Strong data integration skills across heterogeneous sources (sensor feeds, drone imagery, satellite data, manual inspection records, government portals)

**Why join**

You'll have founder-level influence on a product that protects communities and critical infrastructure, with the backing of The Ksquare Group and the autonomy of a start-up.

**To apply:**
Send a short note on a dam safety or infrastructure problem you think software should have solved by now, along with your CV or LinkedIn, to varma.buddharaju@theksquaregroup.com

* 3+ years of experience in product management, program management, software engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role.
* Experience defining and delivering a data, analytics, or service feature with engineering partners, including requirements and measures of success.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Project Manager** to plan and manage project and release activities across platform components and customer-facing products. In this role, you will operate with independence, drive agile delivery and ensure programs stay aligned with organizational objectives from inception through successful delivery.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage project/release activities across a group of platform components and customer facing products in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Alignment of dependent organizations and removal or mitigation of all release blocking issues
* Support Release Trains and drive PI (Program Increment) activities
* Collection of project, release and train metrics to provide insights and share lessons learned
* Deep diving to understand the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies
* Operate across development, product and operations support overseeing the gaps between teams, processes and systems, while removing blocking issues that would introduce risk to a project and release
* Facilitate a variety of release ceremonies including change review board, release status, release readiness reviews, go/no go, implementation plan reviews and release retrospectives
* Regular review of metrics to proactively ensure the program stays aligned with organization objectives
* Application of continuous improvement methodologies across teams through data driven decision-making
* Relationship building, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of individuals across the organization

**Requirements**

* 10-12 years of experience in software development
* Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
* Experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
* Proficiency in Agile practices with strong understanding of SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) and SDLC (software development life cycle)
* Strong background in Technical Project and/or Program Management
* Proven track record of data driven decision-making
* BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline

**Nice to have**

* Expertise in Payments, IaaS and PaaS
* Familiarity with serverless technology, CI/CD and NoSQL databases
* Knowledge of microservices APIs and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model

jobs.title: IT Project Manager - Java/.NET
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly accomplished, technically astute **IT Project Manager** with 10-14 years of professional experience to spearhead the delivery of our enterprise-grade software applications.

In this position, you will guide cross-functional software development teams delivering complex projects built on modern **Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks**. Your responsibility will be to lead the end-to-end Agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), spanning cloud-native microservices development, legacy application modernization, and API integrations.

You will oversee projects where **ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Copilot, or other AI tools** are utilized. APIs are being embedded into our Java or .NET backends to create intelligent user experiences (such as chat assistants, intelligent document analysis, or automated workflows).

You will apply the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to boost sprint velocity and code quality, while simultaneously overseeing the delivery of applications that embed these models directly into our enterprise products.

The perfect candidate has a solid technical foundation (preferably a background in software engineering or systems architecture) and holds the strategic mindset needed to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, oversee multi-million dollar budgets, and advocate for modern Agile methodologies.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Act as a highly technical liaison between developers, architects, product owners, and business leaders
* Guide the team through complex project milestones involving Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Facilitate discussions around technical debt, code quality, automated testing (unit/integration/E2E), and CI/CD pipeline bottlenecks
* Oversee dependencies and risks associated with hybrid architectures (e.g., migrating legacy .NET Framework or Java EE monolithic systems to modern, containerized cloud environments)
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior leadership and business stakeholders, providing transparent reporting on project health, roadmap progress, and technical risks
* Identify, track, and proactively mitigate risks, technical dependencies, and blockers before they impact delivery timelines
* Collaborate with Product Management to align the technical roadmap with business priorities and product backlogs

**Requirements**

* 10-14 years of professional experience in IT project management
* Expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and scaled agile frameworks (SAFe)
* Advanced proficiency in project management and collaboration tools, specifically Jira, Confluence, and MS Project
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Capability to perform capacity planning, estimating, and resource allocation in a fast-paced environment
* Understanding of Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, and RESTful APIs
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines
* Background in integrating AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Co-Pilot) into enterprise applications
* Showcase of outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value
* Skills in strong negotiation and conflict resolution
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-change environment

**Nice to have**

* Qualifications in project management: PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner

Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) is a Fortune 500 company that operates a leading network of global futures, equity and equity options exchanges, as well as global clearing and data services across financial and commodity markets.

By putting the needs of our customers and global participants first, we are a high-growth company that started by bringing transparency and risk management to the global derivatives markets. We’re engineers, strategists and problem-solvers who continually create and improve technology that solves market structure challenges on behalf of the industry.

The Treasury department is a critical function in a systemically important organization; the team is responsible for managing the collateral and liquidity position in the Clearing House including:

* Coordination with Clearing Members, commercial banks, investment managers, custodians and regulators
* Managing all member payments and receipts, and all bank accounts
* Ensuring all collateral reconciliation and reporting analyses are performed daily
* Liaising with other departments including Operations, Risk, Finance, and Technology
* Working with Technology Business Analysts to automate processes and enhance reporting
* Ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and procedures

Treasury team covers multiple currencies and markets, and this role will be coordinated in UK Business Hours. The role incorporates both daily routine processes and strategic project work.

ICE Clear Europe staff demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism throughout their work and lead by example to create a collaborative and supportive culture. The candidate should be able to learn and understand processes quickly, identify improvements, collaboratively develop and clearly communicate proposals and then implement solutions in order to solve problems and enhance the performance of the department. Specific personal characteristics will include a strong desire to deliver results in a dynamic and forward-looking environment and an eagerness to continuously develop through working as part of the Treasury team and self-initiated learning.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor the full life-cycle of collateral settlement through the Clearing House, assisting with the placement of cash into high quality, low risk investments across multiple currencies
* Provide support to our Clearing Members and respond to queries
* Identify opportunities for business process improvements by reviewing existing Treasury processes and procedures
* Work on strategic projects in collaboration with Business Analysts to document requirements and deliver enhancements
* Understand the broad macro and regulatory environment in UK, EU and US to help internal as well as external partners Complete periodic tasks in areas such as audit, finance, onboarding, and reporting
* Assist with project management of a large body of tactical and strategic projects

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics or Engineering
* Strong interpersonal skills, including ability to multi-task and operate effectively under tight deadlines
* Proficient in all MS applications, high level of experience with Excel
* Interest in Clearing, Derivatives and Bond markets
* Organized and motivated with excellent attention to detail
* Familiarity with Swift, payment market Infrastructure including payments, collateral settlements and clearing workflows
* Knowledge of Treasury workflows in large organization is preferred

Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate and transform reference data structures/events/sub-processes with higher complexity provided in a variety legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class expanding subject matter expertise for additional structures and/or asset classes with minimal oversight from senior members of the team.

* Research and remediate the data discrepancies identified by Clients.

* Identify trends and causation of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with regulatory initiatives, new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.

* Support client facing members of ICE Data Services by conducting analysis and providing responses as questions and challenges arise.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operatio…

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. **Role Overview**
The
**Business Analyst for ServiceNow Development**
is a pivotal role within our enterprise technology division. In this position, you will serve as the primary strategic liaison between business stakeholders and our technical engineering teams. * Define testing strategies and compile comprehensive test scenarios to validate that developed features meet all defined acceptance criteria.
* Facilitate and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders, acting as the first line of triage for defects and functional feedback.

* Create, maintain, and publish user guides, knowledge articles, and training materials to support successful platform adoption.
* Assist with post-deployment support and gather user feedback to inform future development cycles.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Education Bachelor's degree in business administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Professional Experience Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst, with at least 2 years of dedicated focus supporting ServiceNow platform implementation, development, or migrations.
* Agile Expertise Proven hands-on experience working within Agile/Scrum frameworks, including deep familiarity with backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow Agile 2.0).
* Platform Knowledge Strong foundational understanding of core ServiceNow modules (such as ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, or CSM) and how they integrate with wider enterprise ecosystems.
* Analytical Skills Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to map, optimize, and simplify complex business processes.
* Communication Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical jargon into clear business value for stakeholders of all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will shape the strategic vision and own the roadmap for a complex product domain. You will partner with Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams to establish short- and long-term goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Principal Product Manager based in India is a strategic senior individual contributor who serves as a force multiplier across product strategy, platform evolution, and AI transformation within Target’s Service Centre product ecosystem. This role provides strategic product leadership across business and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. The Principal Product Manager will shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, AI-enabled experiences, operational platforms, and enterprise insight capabilities serving Guests, team members, partners, and business functions. The role partners closely with the Director of Product Management to transform core servicing capabilities and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and intelligent experiences.

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role is demonstrated through the ability to shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, elevate product management maturity, influence enterprise priorities without direct authority, and deliver measurable improvements in Guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The Principal Product Manager is a strategic thought leader, trusted partner, mentor, and force multiplier who accelerates product excellence across the TES portfolio.

**Strategic Product Leadership**

* Establish a clear multi-year vision and roadmap for Digital Servicing, AI-powered experiences, and servicing platforms.
* Influence product investment decisions to align with TES and enterprise priorities.
* Translate complex business challenges into scalable product opportunities with measurable outcomes.

**Business and Product Outcomes**

* Improve servicing outcomes across Guest experience, team member productivity, operational efficiency, adoption, automation, and cost to serve.
* Deliver measurable progress against product OKRs and enterprise priorities.
* Ensure product investments generate measurable business value rather than technology outputs alone.

**Product Maturity and Capability Building**

* Elevate product management practices across discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, roadmap development, measurement, and storytelling.
* Coach and mentor product practitioners, strengthening customer-centric problem-solving and outcome-based decision-making.
* Establish consistent product discipline and effective product-management practices across TES teams.

**Enterprise Influence**

* Serve as a trusted adviser to Product, Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business leaders.
* Strengthen alignment between business strategy and product execution.
* Reduce decision-making friction and accelerate execution across organisational and functional boundaries

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management or equivalent domain experience, preferably within retail, consumer servicing, enterprise platforms, or AI-enabled products.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and roadmaps for complex, enterprise-scale products or platforms.
* Deep expertise in product discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, outcome-based roadmaps, and product measurement.
* Experience leading product-driven transformation across Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams.
* Strong understanding of digital servicing, automation, AI-enabled experiences, data flows, and platform capabilities.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor product practitioners and elevate product-management maturity.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, storytelling, and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team-**

It is a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems.

The USP of the team is people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have.

Some examples of the digital solutions for various Core Engineering departments such as Data driven designs of wiring, automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based product aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. It also involve developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such flight test planning etc. In addition to these points, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed; are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc.

M&T is also deeply involved in Agile Scrum and SAFe in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above.

About the Role-

We are looking for a Product Owner who comes from a software development background. You will own the team backlog for an Agile team operating within an Agile Release Train (ART), and you will do it as someone who has written production code, sat through releases, and understands what a story actually costs to build.

This is deliberately a technical Product Owner role. We are not looking for a pure business analyst or a scrum administrator. We want someone who can sit with engineers, read the design, challenge an estimate on its merits, and still hold a credible conversation with stakeholders about value and priority.

You will be the voice of the customer inside the team and the single point of decision on what gets built next.

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**What you'll do-**

  

Own the team backlog

  

* Create, refine and prioritise the team backlog so there is always at least two iterations of ready work

* Break features handed down from Product Management into user stories and technical enablers with clear acceptance criteria

* Sequence work based on value, dependencies, technical risk and capacity and be able to explain the sequence to anyone who asks

* Make informed calls on technical debt and enabler work, because you understand what it buys the team Drive the SAFe cadence

* Represent the team at PI Planning: contribute to planning objectives, negotiate scope, surface and resolve dependencies with other teams on the train

* Run backlog refinement and participate in Iteration Planning, Iteration Review, System Demo and Inspect & Adapt

* Work alongside the Scrum Master / Team Coach, Product Management, the RTE and the System Architect to keep the team aligned with ART priorities Accept the work

* Be the sole accepter of stories against defined acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done

* Validate what was built against what was intended, including non-functional requirements performance, security, maintainability

* Provide fast, unambiguous answers to the team during the iteration; unblocking is a core part of the job, not an interruption Represent the customer and the stakeholders

* Gather input from users, business stakeholders and support/operations, and translate it into backlog items

* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, trade-offs and changes no surprises at the demo

* Push back, with reasoning, when scope requests threaten quality or committed PI objectives

  

**Skills Needed-**

  

Essential:

* Software development life cycle: a solid, practical understanding of the full SDLC requirements, design,

development, testing, release and maintenance and how decisions early in the cycle play out later

* Object-oriented development: hands-on experience building software in at least one of Java, C++ or C#

* Front-end technologies: working experience with front-end frameworks and libraries such as Angular,

jQuery, Ext JS or Node.js

* Demonstrable experience as a Product Owner in a scaled Agile setup (SAFe, or an equivalent multi-team

model such as LeSS or Nexus)

* Practical, first-hand participation in PI Planning and the full SAFe iteration cadence not just theoretical

familiarity

* Strong story writing: clear acceptance criteria, INVEST-shaped stories, well-defined enablers

* Confidence prioritising with an explicit method (WSJF, cost of delay, or similar) and defending those

decisions to senior stakeholders

* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including counterparts in [Europe / other regions]

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English

* Fluency with backlog and collaboration tooling Jira / Azure DevOps, Confluence

  

**Preferred:**

* Aerospace domain experience exposure to aerospace or aviation programmes, systems or regulatory

context

* SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification, or willingness to certify within the first six

months

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows and automated testing practices

* Exposure to data-informed product decisions: defining metrics, reading them, and changing course based on

them

* Experience transitioning from an engineering role into product ownership

  

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Company:**

Airbus India Private Limited

**Employment Type:**

**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. We provide mission-critical communication and data solutions that help our customers make the world safer and more productive.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* **Job Description**

Reporting into our Product Management & Operations leadership, we are seeking a highly operational, execution-driven Product Manager to own the delivery and lifecycle management of the WAVE PTX software portfolio. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between our Product Strategy leaders and our Engineering teams. You will be responsible for taking the strategic product vision and driving it through the development lifecycle, ensuring our engineering teams deliver high-quality software on time, and that our Go-To-Market teams are fully equipped for flawless commercial launches.

* **Key Responsibilities**
  + Execution & Backlog Management: Partner with our Vertical Product Strategy leaders to ingest their product requirements and translate them into deeply detailed, actionable development plans, Epics, and sprint backlogs for engineering.
  + Release Orchestration: Own the software release cadence for WAVE PTX. Drive cross-functional execution across engineering, QA, and operations to ensure timely, defect-free software drops that meet our SaaS commitments.
  + In-Market & Lifecycle Management: Act as the primary operational product owner for the live WAVE PTX platform. Manage sustaining engineering priorities, technical debt resolution, and critical customer escalations to ensure high system reliability and customer retention.
  + Go-To-Market (GTM) Readiness: Spearhead the New Product Introduction (NPI) process for all WAVE PTX releases. Ensure marketing, sales enablement, support, and billing systems are fully prepared before a feature goes live.
  + Agile Bottleneck Resolution: Serve as the daily unblocker for the engineering teams. Proactively identify dependencies, capacity constraints, and technical risks, ruthlessly clearing obstacles to maintain high engineering velocity.
  + Performance Tracking: Monitor post-launch product performance, tracking software adoption rates, system stability metrics, and operational costs, feeding this data back to the strategy teams to inform future roadmaps.

  
  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* Qualifications
  + Experience: 5–8+ years of Technical Product Management, Delivery Management, or Product Operations experience, specifically within a high-velocity, subscription-based software (SaaS) environment.
  + Execution Expertise: Deep mastery of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies. You excel at turning high-level strategic visions into granular engineering tasks.
  + Tool Fluency: Advanced proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Productboard, Aha!, or similar product delivery and ticketing systems.
  + Technical Acumen: Strong ability to communicate deeply technical concepts between engineering architects and commercial business leaders.
  + Operational Rigor: A relentless focus on process, predictability, and quality control. You thrive in structured environments and excel at holding cross-functional teams accountable to deadlines.
  + Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional ability to influence, acting as the trusted operational partner to both Product Visionaries and Engineering Directors.

None

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

No

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. **About the Role**

We're looking for a ***Product Analyst - Lead*** to research new automations and features within the immigration/global mobility space, design workflows and user experiences, and help deliver assigned features from idea to release for Immidart Enterprise – working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and external vendors.

You'll own research, solution design, and UX for the features assigned to you, and bring recommendations to the table. You'll report to an Associate Product Manager or Head of Product, who owns overall roadmap priorities and scope decisions.

**What You'll Do**

* Research new automations, features, and industry best practices within immigration/global mobility (e.g. visa, compliance, or case-management processes), including speaking with clients or domain/compliance experts to understand real-world processes, not just desk research.
* Turn research into clear workflows, business rules, and requirements – covering the main flow, edge cases, and any compliance or regulatory checks that apply.
* Demo proposed solutions, wireframes, or prototypes to internal stakeholders and clients before and during build, to validate direction early and avoid rework.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that give Engineering and QA enough detail to build and test without back-and-forth.
* Design wireframes and mock-ups for web and mobile screens, and rework existing screens based on client or user feedback (layout, navigation, missing information, etc.).
* Identify and define integrations with any external tools, client systems, or government/regulatory portals needed for end-to-end automation – including what data needs to flow where, and any authentication or validation steps involved.
* Where work is outsourced to an external vendor, own the scope: define clear requirements, track progress against agreed timelines, review deliverables against what was asked for, and take responsibility for the quality of what gets delivered.
* Join sprint planning and backlog refinement for your features, and stay available to answer Engineering/QA questions as they come up during the build.
* See assigned features through to release – supporting UAT, launch, and early monitoring – and gather client/user feedback afterward to feed into the next round of improvements.
* Keep specs, process flows, and other documentation current for the features you own, so anyone picking up the work later has the full context.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4–6 years of experience in Product Analysis, Business Analysis, or a similar product role.
* Experience researching a new process, feature, or regulatory topic on your own and presenting findings clearly.
* Hands-on experience with wireframes or mock-ups (Figma, Balsamiq, or similar).
* Comfort writing requirements, user stories, and workflow documentation.
* Comfort interviewing clients or subject-matter experts to understand a process, and presenting/demoing your findings or solutions back to them.
* Experience working with external vendors or development partners.
* Basic understanding of APIs and how system integrations work.
* Experience in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills – you can explain a complex idea simply.
* Experience in immigration, global mobility, HR tech, or another compliance-heavy, regulated industry.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to AI-assisted design tools (Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor, or similar).
* Experience with mobile app requirements and design.

**Growth Path**

This role is a stepping stone to Associate Product Manager. Analysts who take on full ownership of scope decisions and end-to-end delivery for a module are well-positioned to grow into that role.

The Product Control Global Service Centre team is responsible for end-to-end product control tasks including but not limited to preparation, analysis, and reporting of Profit & Loss and Profit & Loss attribution, to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger and balance sheet. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Seller Payments
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.
  
  
In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.
  
  
This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
* Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
* Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:

+ Receive or earn funds
+ Add or reload money
+ Hold and manage their balance
+ Spend funds back on the eBay platform

* Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
* Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
* Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
* Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
* Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
* Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
* Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
* A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
* Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
* Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
* Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
* Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
* High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
* A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
