**About MyHQ**
myHQ is India's largest commercial real estate and flex workspace marketplace. Founded in 2016 by IIT Delhi graduates, we give 50,000+ enterprises- from early-stage startups to large MNCs and GCCs, access to 10,000+ workspace options across 10+ cities, covering coworking, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and managed offices.
  
  
In five years we've grown 30x and closed two back to back profitable years. Backed by ANAROCK Group and WeWork India, we're building toward ₹1,000Cr, and hiring the team that gets us there.
  
  
We believe where you work shapes what you build. Our mission is to make the right workspace accessible to every business in India, and increasingly, beyond it. With expansion already underway in Dubai and London, we're building something with a genuinely large surface area.
  
  
For the people who join us, that translates to real opportunity. We've paid out over ₹10Cr in performance bonuses in the last couple of years, and we've watched team members buy homes, build wealth, and grow into roles that didn't exist when they joined. The next five years will be harder than the last five, and significantly more rewarding.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**We Look For People With The Following Characteristics**

* Humble and hardworking: Two traits we hire for and live by; the best people here are the ones who show up fully and let the work speak
* High ownership: You'll own real work from day one, not just assist on it; the buck stops with you, and leadership backs you up
* Bias for action: We move fast, learn faster, and don't overthink; experimentation is encouraged, paralysis is not
* Open and direct: Smart people, honest conversations, no politics; feedback flows both ways and that's how we get better

**About The Role**
myHQ is looking for a Product Manager to join our product team. You will own key product areas end-to-end, from discovery and prioritisation to shipping and measuring outcomes. We're looking for someone who is AI-native, takes high ownership, and can move fast without losing sight of the user. If you thrive in ambiguity, think in systems, and want your work to have real business impact, this role is for you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product roadmap for assigned areas, driving prioritisation based on user needs, business goals, and data.
* Write detailed PRDs and create functional prototypes to clearly communicate product intent to engineering and design.
* Define clear problem statements and align engineering and design on what to build and why.
* Conduct user research, analyse behavioural data, and synthesise insights into actionable product decisions.
* Leverage AI tools natively to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, spec writing, and competitive research.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, and ops to ship features end-to-end.
* Monitor product health through dashboards, funnels, and KPIs; own outcomes, not just output.
* Identify and drive process improvements across product workflows.
* Proactively communicate product decisions, trade-offs, and learnings to leadership and stakeholders.

**Desired Skills / Experience**

* 2-5 years of product management experience, ideally at a product-led or growth-stage startup.
* AI-native mindset, actively using LLMs and AI tools as part of daily workflow (research, writing, prototyping, analysis).
* High ownership mentality, taking end-to-end accountability for outcomes, not just tasks.
* Ability to write crisp PRDs and build functional prototypes (Figma, no-code tools, or similar).
* Strong analytical skills; comfort with data, funnels, and product metrics.
* Familiarity with SQL and product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar).
* Excellent written communication, able to write clear PRDs, specs, and stakeholder updates.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete information.
* Curious, humble, and opinionated; strong product opinions, loosely held.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in SaaS, B2B, or marketplace products.
* Exposure to compliance, fintech, or real estate verticals.
* Experience with design tools (Figma) or no-code prototyping tools.
* Experience working with CRM, Google Analytics, or BI tools

**People & Culture**

* Autonomy + Ownership: You'll own product areas end-to-end with full accountability for outcomes and the freedom to make calls.
* Speed + Learning: We move fast and encourage rapid experimentation. You'll get direct exposure to cross-functional teams and real-time decision-making.
* AI-First Environment: We build with AI, not around it. Your ideas will be shaped by and amplified through AI tools every day.

**Frequently Asked Questions**
**What's the interview process like?**
**The Interview Process Consists Of 2-3 Rounds**
(i) past product work, ownership examples, and analytical thinking;
  
  
(ii) product sense, problem-solving, and strategy;
  
  
(iii) a short take-home case study or live product exercise.
  
  
**Our Products**

* Day Passes: On demand access to coworking spaces across India, booked by the day
* Meeting Rooms: Hourly bookings across 2,000+ venues in 10+ cities
* Virtual Offices: Registered business address with GST support and mail handling
* Managed Offices: Fully fitted, ready-to-move offices with no long-term lock-in
* Enterprise Leasing: End-to-end commercial leasing for large teams, handled by our Assisted Marketplace team
* MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibition): Venue sourcing and management for corporate events, trainings, off-sites, and conferences

jobs.title: Product Manager (RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

The Azure Cloud and CI/CD Subject Matter Expert owns the architecture, engineering, automation, security, governance, cost optimization, and operational maturity of Microsoft Azure environments and software delivery platforms. This hands-on role establishes cloud and Dev SecOps standards, builds reusable infrastructure and deployment patterns, and partners with application, security, finance, product, and operations teams to deliver secure, resilient, observable, and cost-effective services.

* Serve as the technical authority for Azure architecture, platform engineering, networking, identity, security, governance, resiliency, and operations.

* Create architecture diagrams, pipeline standards, implementation guides, operational procedures, and evidence supporting security, compliance, and change management.
* Mentor engineers and collaborate with development, database, networking, security, quality, product, and vendor teams.

**Role Overview**

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers? Do you obsess over the quality of your software? Do you insist on the highest standards for the software your team develops? Are you an advocate of measurable quality? Can you dive deep and still maintain the big picture of your solution’s components and the customer experience? Well, if this is you, then come join an energetic team of engineers building future of PDI software solutions.

As a Test Automation Engineer (a.k.a. Software Engineer in Test) you will be part of an Agile team and involved in all aspects of our projects’ lifecycle from inception through release working closely with the team’s product owner, architects and engineers. jobs.description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Analyst for a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The analyst reports to the IAM Lead.

The IAM Analyst ensures that system access is maintained in accordance with company policy and supports access-management controls across infrastructure systems. The role provides day-to-day support and maintenance for network and application access, manages identity creation and the complete identity lifecycle, validates access-management data, and maintains security processes and solutions that mitigate or remediate identified risks.

Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.

**PRIMARY ROLE**

  

* Manage the complete user-account lifecycle for applications integrated with Microsoft Active Directory (AD) and external applications not integrated with AD, including provisioning, deprovisioning, monitoring, securing and deactivation.
* Process daily requests for application and system access; validate access-change requests from Human Resources; and grant or deny access according to employee job responsibilities and approved authorization.
* Enforce company IAM policies and procedures, identify discrepancies between assigned and required access rights, and take appropriate corrective action.
* Conduct recurring access reviews and audits to identify dormant, orphaned or inappropriate accounts and records, disable them and remove access as required.
* Support IAM control activities across infrastructure systems using the enterprise IAM platform.
* Manage Active Directory permissions through role-based access control (RBAC).
* Manage access and rulesets for Microsoft 365 shared resources, including distribution lists, shared calendars and shared mailboxes.
* Configure, manage and validate automated workflows in the IAM platform.
* Manage the IAM Help Desk ticket queue from receipt through resolution, including ticket creation and updates, triage, troubleshooting, escalation, incident documentation and reporting, user communication, training and closure comments.

This role focuses on **business definitions, data standards, functional requirements, and process design** , helping to ensure master data is accurate, consistent, governed, and fit for operational, analytical, and regulatory use. * Support communication, training, and adoption of master data processes and standards within the business.

Contribute to the ongoing maturity of Master Data Management and Data Governance capabilities.

* Strong understanding of **Master Data Management concepts, data domains, and lifecycle processes** .

* Solid knowledge of **data governance and data quality principles** .

Experience working with enterprise data standards, business rules, and process documentation is preferred.

2026-10-19

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. The ideal candidate will take end-to-end ownership of features, ensuring clarity of requirements, smooth execution, and timely delivery while maintaining strong alignment with business objectives. * Proficiency with Azure DevOps for feature and backlog management.

We are looking for a highly skilled **Excel & Real Estate Feasibility Analyst** who can independently develop, maintain, and improve Excel-based feasibility models for residential and real-estate development projects.

* Create and maintain complex Excel-based financial and feasibility models.
* Build models using formulas so that changing any major input automatically updates all related calculations.
* Develop interconnected worksheets for project costing, revenue, profitability, cash flow, and feasibility.
* Maintain professional formatting, structure, formulas, validations, and error checks.
* Improve existing Excel models without disturbing the original structure and presentation.

2. Real Estate Project Feasibility

Prepare feasibility calculations for:

* Residential apartment projects
* Villa projects
* Land development projects
* Joint Development (JD) projects
* Landowner–developer sharing models
* Pre-launch and post-launch sales models

Calculate and analyse:

* Land area and conversion
* Acre / Guntas / Sq.Ft. calculations
* FAR / FSI
* Ground coverage
* Built-up area (BUA)
* Saleable area
* Carpet area / efficiency
* Number of apartments

We strive to be a customer-centric division, using the latest technologies and innovations to serve our customers in a manner that is authentic with the brand values.

**Soft Skills:**

* Collaboration: Working effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.
* Adaptability: Being flexible and open to changes in a dynamic, agile environment.
* Problem-solving: Approaching challenges with a solution-oriented mindset.

**Education:**

**Nice to Have:**
